feature: I got it: the buy tag as the way in, the confirm (PR 2), and the receipt, undo and held slot (PR 3)
note: Run against a server started with SHOPPING_MARK_BOUGHT_ENABLED=true and COLLECTION_EDIT_ENABLED=true. READ-ONLY: no step submits the confirm. IGI_DECK is a deck the signed-in account owns with at least one Shopping row (an unowned or short card). Pull real decks with pull:staging onto a scratch branch first; a fixture account rarely has a Shopping list worth reading. PR 3's rows `receipt` and `undo-warning` are WRITING rows: they press Add, which records a copy in the signed-in account's collection, and `undo-warning` reverts it. Run them on a scratch Neon branch holding a pull:staging copy and never on staging or production. `undo-warning` needs IGI_SHORT_DECK: a deck whose Shopping row's card a second, OLDER committed deck also lacks, so the undo would leave that other deck short; without one the undo goes straight through and the row photographs the done form instead.

rows.label: /decks/[id] Shopping: the buy tag at rest as the button, and the head's key
/decks/[id] Shopping rows: the tag at rest beside every neighbor; below lg, buy over `over $X` as one target
/decks/[id] Shopping: the confirm open from a row's tag, preset to the printing behind the price
/decks/[id] All: the collapsed $ tag stays inert (no Bought button)
/decks/[id] Shopping after a press (WRITING): the receipt in the toast slot, and the row's held slot or the row redrawn in place
/decks/[id] Shopping, Undo on the receipt (WRITING): Checking decks…, then §E as `Undoing leaves a deck short` (dialog, sheet)
